articles.description: Left-wing opposition parties led by Magdalena Andersson look set to form the next government.

articles.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
articles.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

articles.title: EU offers Canada chance to become first 'associate member' in wake of Trump's trade war

articles.title: Reward offered after British woman is kidnapped in Malawi
articles.description: Police in Malawi have offered a reward after a British woman was kidnapped in the southern African country.

articles.title: Kosovo's former president jailed for 25 years over war crimes
articles.description: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaci has been jailed for 25 years after being found criminally responsible for war crimes following a trial in The Hague.

articles.title: At least 21 killed and dozens trapped after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
articles.description: At least 21 Palestinians, including eight children, who were sheltering in a bombed-out apartment building in Gaza have been killed after the structure collapsed overnight.
